tristram shandy.title: The Life and Opinions of Tristram Shandy, Gentleman
tristram shandy.author: Laurence Sterne

impossible creatures.title: Impossible Creatures

changing planes.title: Changing Planes

crucible.title: The Crucible
crucible.author: Arthur Miller
crucible.why: Miller's play about the Salem witch trials as an allegory for McCarthyism; a school staple that readers still talk about.

untethered soul.title: The Untethered Soul
untethered soul.author: Michael A. Singer

princess academy.title: Princess Academy
princess academy.author: Shannon Hale

chain.title: The Chain
chain.author: Adrian McKinty

almanac of the dead.title: Almanac of the Dead
almanac of the dead.author: Leslie Silko
almanac of the dead.why: A sprawling, angry novel of Native American resistance, crime and history across the Americas.

seabiscuit.title: Seabiscuit: An American Legend
seabiscuit.author: Laura Hillenbrand
seabiscuit.why: The true story of an underdog racehorse and his team during the Depression; better than the movie, readers say.

at the mountains of madness.title: At the Mountains of Madness
at the mountains of madness.author: H.P. Lovecraft

code of the woosters.title: The Code of the Woosters
code of the woosters.author: P. G. Wodehouse
code of the woosters.why: Bertie Wooster and Jeeves in a tangle of stolen silver and newts; Wodehouse at his funniest.

tinker tailor soldier spy.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
tinker tailor soldier spy.author: John le Carré

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.author: Greg Egan

rainbows end.title: Rainbows End
rainbows end.author: Vernor Vinge

bad cree.title: Bad Cree
bad cree.author: Jessica Johns
bad cree.why: A young Cree woman's dreams carry things into waking life; a lyrical horror debut that readers rated highly.

skin.title: Skin
skin.author: Kathe Koja
skin.why: The comments about this title name other books with 'skin', so there is no clear recommendation for it.

stone blind.title: Stone Blind
stone blind.author: Natalie Haynes
stone blind.why: The Medusa story retold from her point of view; praised retelling of Greek myth.

love hypothesis.title: The Love Hypothesis
love hypothesis.author: Ali Hazelwood
love hypothesis.why: A popular romance, but the comments mostly dismiss its writing as poor.

traveling cat chronicles.title: The Travelling Cat Chronicles
traveling cat chronicles.author: Hiro Arikawa
traveling cat chronicles.why: A man and his cat go on a road trip to find a new home for the cat; warm and quietly moving.

radix.title: Radix
radix.author: A. A. Attanasio
radix.why: A boy wanders a strange transformed Earth in a trippy, far-future epic; cult favourite.

downward to the earth.title: Downward to the Earth
downward to the earth.author: Robert Silverberg
downward to the earth.why: A former colonial officer returns to an alien planet and finds a hidden spiritual transformation; a haunting Silverberg classic.

brokeback mountain.title: Brokeback Mountain
brokeback mountain.author: Annie Proulx

fever.title: Fever
fever.author: Deon Meyer

gullivers travels.title: Gulliver's Travels
gullivers travels.author: Jonathan Swift

changes.title: Changes
changes.author: Jim Butcher

prince of thorns.title: Prince of Thorns
prince of thorns.author: Mark Lawrence

last continent.title: The Last Continent
last continent.author: Terry Pratchett

snow falling on cedars.title: Snow Falling on Cedars
snow falling on cedars.author: David Guterson

xenocide.title: Xenocide
xenocide.author: Orson Scott Card

emperor of all maladies.title: The Emperor of All Maladies
emperor of all maladies.author: Siddhartha Mukherjee

lost souls.title: Lost Souls
lost souls.author: Poppy Z. Brite
lost souls.why: Vampires and teenage runaways in a gothic, sensual horror novel; a cult favourite.

small changes.title: Small changes
small changes.author: Marge Piercy
small changes.why: The comments do not discuss this novel, so the match is unclear.

meridian.title: Blood Meridian
meridian.author: Cormac McCarthy
meridian.why: A teenage runaway joins scalp hunters in the 1850s borderlands; brutal, majestic prose.

in five years.title: In five years
in five years.author: Rebecca Serle
in five years.why: A woman dreams of her future five years ahead and then lives to see it unfold; a quick, emotional read.

cinder.title: Cinder
cinder.author: Marissa Meyer
cinder.why: A cyborg mechanic in New Beijing takes on a twist on Cinderella; fun and lasting for fans.

sot weed factor.title: The Sot-Weed Factor
sot weed factor.author: John Barth

denial of death.title: The Denial of Death
denial of death.author: Ernest Becker
denial of death.why: A Pulitzer-winning study of how fear of death shapes human behaviour; deep and unsettling.

gods of jade and shadow.title: Gods of Jade and Shadow
gods of jade and shadow.author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
gods of jade and shadow.why: A Mexican girl teams up with a Mayan death god for a quest through 1920s Mexico; mythical and vivid.

tilt.title: Tilt
tilt.author: Emma Pattee
tilt.why: A pregnant woman walks across Portland during a massive earthquake; a tense, powerful novel of a day.

black dahlia.title: The Black Dahlia
black dahlia.author: James Ellroy
black dahlia.why: Two cops become obsessed with a real 1947 Hollywood murder; a dark noir by Ellroy.

yellow wife.title: Yellow Wife
yellow wife.author: Sadeqa Johnson
yellow wife.why: An enslaved woman's story of survival in a Virginia slave jail; hard but very good.

fountains of paradise.title: The Fountains of Paradise
fountains of paradise.author: Arthur C. Clarke
fountains of paradise.why: An engineer's project to build a space elevator; a thoughtful, hard-sci-fi favourite.

tipping the velvet.title: Tipping the Velvet
tipping the velvet.author: Sarah Waters
tipping the velvet.why: A music-hall girl in Victorian London finds love and herself; a richly written, sensual debut.

crown of stars.title: Crown of Stars
crown of stars.author: Kate Elliott
crown of stars.why: A long, low-magic epic fantasy in an early medieval-style world with a diverse cast; praised for getting history right.

my uncle oswald.title: My Uncle Oswald
my uncle oswald.author: Roald Dahl

ritual.title: The Ritual
ritual.author: Adam Nevill

un lun dun.title: Un Lun Dun
un lun dun.author: China Miéville
un lun dun.why: Two girls enter a strange, mirrored London; a go-to young adult fantasy recommended for kids who've been through hard times.

death in venice.title: Death in Venice
death in venice.author: Thomas Mann
death in venice.why: An ageing writer becomes obsessed with a boy in Venice; a famous, elegant novella.

pickwick papers.title: The Pickwick Papers
pickwick papers.author: Charles Dickens
pickwick papers.why: A comic series of adventures of an English club leader and his friends; Dickens' warm, funny debut.

good material.title: Good Material
good material.author: Dolly Alderton

doors of eden.title: The Doors of Eden
doors of eden.author: Adrian Tchaikovsky

robinson crusoe.title: Robinson Crusoe
robinson crusoe.author: Daniel Defoe

dreamcatcher.title: Dreamcatcher
dreamcatcher.author: Stephen King

made for love.title: Made for Love
made for love.author: Alissa Nutting
made for love.why: A woman escapes her tech-billionaire husband who has linked her mind to his; a crazy, believably dystopian satire.

american dirt.title: American Dirt
american dirt.author: Jeanine Cummins

barbarian days.title: Barbarian days
barbarian days.author: William Finnegan
barbarian days.why: A surfer's memoir of a life chasing waves around the world; much deeper than it sounds.

wake.title: The Wake
wake.author: Paul Kingsnorth
wake.why: A Saxon man resists the Norman Conquest, told in a shadow-tongue of Old English; demanding but striking.

metamorphoses.title: Metamorphoses
metamorphoses.author: Ovid
metamorphoses.why: Ovid's long narrative poem retelling Greek and Roman myths of change.

charlie and the chocolate factory.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
charlie and the chocolate factory.author: Roald Dahl
charlie and the chocolate factory.why: Children win a tour of a strange candy factory; cute and funny, with sharp touches of satire.

dead astronauts.title: Dead Astronauts
dead astronauts.author: Jeff VanderMeer

river god.title: River god
river god.author: Wilbur Smith

mars.title: Mars
mars.author: Fritz Zorn

free.title: Free: Coming of Age at the End of History
free.author: Lea Ypi
free.why: Growing up in communist Albania and its fall, by a philosopher; praised for combining history and humour.

antarctica.title: Antarctica

digital fortress.title: Digital Fortress

killer inside me.title: The Killer Inside Me
killer inside me.author: Jim Thompson

lacuna.title: The Lacuna

colony.title: The Colony
colony.author: Audrey Magee

bartimaeus sequence.title: The Bartimaeus Sequence

anima rising.title: Anima Rising
anima rising.author: Christopher Moore
